Name: Krobus Sells More Stuff -KroSMS-
Author: Oenaqba
Description:
Krobus will now sell..

Living hat - 27500 Fiber - (I made this a feature because everyone I know and then some has trouble getting this hat. So if your either really committed or far enough in the game you can get the fiber needed.)

Tiger Slime Egg - 25 Ginger

Red Slime Egg - 10 Ruby's

Blue Slime Egg - 3 Diamonds

Green Slime Egg - 5 Emeralds

Purple Slime Egg - 25 Amythyst

Soda Machine - 555'555 - (The reason I made it so expensive is because this is also for if you do the community center and wanna have a achievement to show your wealth.)

Panda Hat - 7500 Rice - (I had a theme for this item, if you wanna try growing the rice, or being rich enough to buy all the rice, you can get this usually unable to be obtained hat.)

Pumpkin mask - 350 Pumpkins - (Just for fun. This can usually be tailored, won't say what you tailor tho :> )

Golden Egg - 20'000'000 - (Since this item can usually only be obtained VIA perfection, I made it ridiculously priced. If you wanna skip protection for golden chickens, you gotta work for it.)

- There might be a few updates where I add more items! I hope you like it!
